description: Asks what Len and LenB return for empty and ordinary text, accented, euro, surrogate-pair, lone-surrogate and NUL characters, a long computed text, and for number, Boolean, Date, Currency, Byte, Null, a 12-digit integer and floating operands (the length of the converted text and the stored byte width). Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
